claims.statement: Tom Allen said he was in correspondence with Jem Smith, who told him he would not fight Sullivan east of Omaha.
claims.excerpt: Jem in correspondence with Smith and he telis me that he will not fight Sullivan east of Qmaha.

claims.statement: Tom Allen said a Smith-Sullivan fight would be for the championship, and no championship could be won under other rules than London prize-ring rules.
claims.excerpt: fullivan wouid be for the championship gui no championship could be won under gor other rules.

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: he must fight him under London prize-ring rules, with bare fists, of course.
quotes.topic: London prize-ring rules for a Smith-Sullivan fight

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: No gloves can be used at all.

notes: Interview text is partly garbled; the second claim is low confidence. 'Sullivan' is the paper's spelling for John L. Sullivan.
